evidenceKind: current task helper execution with synthetic persistence dependencies; not a D11 model or database test

observations.name: link-stage failure leaves the helper-created task; same-input retry creates another
event-stage failure leaves task and link without event
default actor_and_queue assigns the requester as well as selected queue

limits: The synthetic dependencies retain writes just like separately committed calls; no production transaction was exercised.

Requester assignment is current intentional helper behavior; it is a misuse risk for specialist delegation, not a proven current product incident.
No environment loading, app bootstrap, DB/Auth/RLS, provider, network or future D11 task state machine tested.
